events.title: AI on track to ‘crowd out’ human decision-making in warfare
events.summary: Artificial intelligence is already being widely used on the battlefield, and the role of human judgment in military operations is shrinking rapidly, the head of the UN’s independent disarmament research institute warned on Tuesday.

events.title: As Sudan war spills into Central African Republic, UN warns against early peacekeeper exit
events.summary: The UN warned on Tuesday against a premature withdrawal of its peacekeepers as the war in Sudan spills over into the Central African Republic (CAR).

events.title: Yemen war continues to force families from homes amid hunger and disease
events.summary: More than 250,000 people have now fled renewed fighting in Yemen, the UN said on Tuesday, citing particular concern for those sheltering in the southwestern city of Taiz and the wider governorate, where access is “essentially blocked”.
